# Fixture provenance — Track3P module Phases 0 and 3

Frozen 2026-09-14 for Phase 0 of `plans/track3p_module_plan.md`;
`pillbox_fieldemission_n1/` added 2026-10-01 by Phase 3 step 2.

Every file here is a **verbatim copy** of a real Track3P input or output, except
where a truncation or a row selection is recorded below. Nothing under
`tests/fixtures/` is generated by the test suite. To refresh, re-copy from the
sources named here and update this file.

Two source trees, neither version-controlled:

- **Probe runs** — `/sdf/scratch/users/d/dbizzoze/lume-ace3p-tests/track3p_probe{,3,4,5}/`,
  the CW23 Pillbox mesh (`Pillbox.ncdf`, 63 091 elements) + `omega3p` +
  `track3p`, run 2026-09-14 on one milano node with 16 MPI ranks using the group
  binary `/sdf/group/rfar/ace3p/bin/track3p` (ACE3P source date 2026-08-21, tag
  `b7f4a98f`, compiled 2026-08-28). Each job finished in under 90 s. Scratch is
  not permanent, which is why these are copied in. `track3p_probe5/` is Phase
  3's (2026-10-01, same group binary), jobs 39649793 and 39651022.
- **Lixin Ge's LCLS-II package** —
  `/sdf/group/rfar/geant4/example/ace3p-geant4-workflow-LCLS-polycone/` (handoff
  2026-09-10) for the field-emission dump and the reweighted Geant4 particle
  file, and the run directory
  `/sdf/scratch/rfar/lge/LCLS-Cromodules/s3df/c3-solo/out/` for its log.

## `pillbox_scan/` — the 3-level secondary-emission run

Source: `track3p_probe/track3p_results/` (input `Pillbox.track3p`, no second
positional argument, so the default results directory).

| File | State | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `track3p.log` | full (106 lines) | Version banner, MPI layout, mesh read from the Omega3P results, a KVC `Mesh` echo inside `/* */`, then `number of all emitting faces = 14`, one `scale … Field …` line per level, and the terminator `Done!`. **No** `Total Emitted Particles` line — a secondary-emission run does not write one. No wall-time line either. |
| `track3p.warn` | full | Three `Key … undefined, using default` warnings about the Omega3P `SurfaceMaterial`. |
| `InputParameters` | full | The build's echo of every recognised key with its default and a comment — the best documentation of the build that exists. `FieldScales` here is what the module reads for the declared levels. |
| `OUTPUT/enhancementCounter` | full (7 data rows) | Bare (uncommented) header `fieldlevel ID enhancement averageEnhancement maxEnhancement maxEnhancementImpactNum totalImpactNum FinalImpactLocationX FinalImpactLocationY FinalImpactLocationZ`. Rows per level: 1 at 2.3e7, 3 at 2.4e7, 3 at 2.5e7. Three more columns than the `en` file `acdtool postprocess track3p` writes (`tests/fixtures/acdtool/track3p_outputs/Pillbox-2.3MV.en`). |
| `OUTPUT/resonantparticles` | **selected**: header + first 40 rows of each level | Bare header `Field_Level ID Resonant_X Resonant_Y Resonant_Z Energy Initial_X Initial_Y Initial_Z Total_time Total_Num`. The original has 1 554 rows grouped by level (588 / 396 / 570 at 2.3e7 / 2.4e7 / 2.5e7); the fixture keeps the first 40 of each group, so per-level counts here are 40/40/40 and **not** the run's. Selection: `awk 'NR==1{print;next}{n[$1]++; if(n[$1]<=40)print}'`; each per-level block is byte-identical to the prefix of the original's. |
| `ImpactsInfo_2.3e+07` | **truncated** `head -n 201` (header + 200 rows) from 13 775 rows | The **default ("general") layout**: bare 17-column header `InitialID ImpactNum Initial_x Initial_y Initial_z Impact_x Impact_y Impact_z InitialPhase ImpactPhase ImpactEnergy NumElectrons momentum_x momentum_y momentum_z FaceID volID`. Rows are fixed-width right-aligned. Row `ImpactNum` values in this prefix: 100 × 0, 92 × 1, 8 × 2. |
| `LostParticles_2.3e+07` | **truncated** `head -n 51` from 1 078 rows | Same 17-column default layout. New since CW23; a particle leaving the domain without impacting. `FaceID`/`volID` are 0. |

Not copied: `OUTPUT/MPParticles<level>` (per-particle `Particle_ID: n
Total_Impacts: m` blocks, not a table; nothing reads it), `ImpactsInfo_2.4e+07`
/ `_2.5e+07` and their `LostParticles_*` (same layout; the file *names* are what
the module reads for the level list, and a test creates empty ones).

## `pillbox_initials_impacts/` — the `Type: Initials-Impacts` dump

Source: `track3p_probe4/b1_initials_impacts/` (input
`Pillbox-b1_initials_impacts.track3p`, results directory `b1_initials_impacts`).

| File | State | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `ImpactsInfo_2.3e+07` | **truncated** `head -n 201` from 14 853 rows | The **17-column `#`-commented layout** `particles.TRACK3P_COLUMNS` names: `#InitialID ImpactOrder Initial_x … ImpactFaceID InitialNormalField InitialFaceArea`. Same run physics as `pillbox_scan`'s 2.3e7 level, different file: no `NumElectrons`, no `volID`, and two field-emission columns instead. This is a secondary-emission run, so the two field-emission columns are **not computed**: `InitialNormalField` is 0 on 194 of the 200 rows and uninitialized memory on the rest (denormals such as `6.373447e-322`, two values near 3e-4); `InitialFaceArea` is 0 (68 rows), the placeholder `1.333130e+00` (64 rows) or uninitialized memory of either sign (68 rows). The columns are only meaningful for `Emitter Type: 7`. |
| `track3p.log` | full | Single-level log; ends `Done!` with no `Total Emitted Particles`. |

## `pillbox_fieldemission/` — Type 7 emitter, Faraday cups, zero particles

Source: `track3p_probe3/w4_type7_model2_fcup/` (input
`Pillbox-w4_type7_model2_fcup.track3p`).

| File | State | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `track3p.log` | full | The one Pillbox log with a `Total Emitted Particles = 0` line **after** `Done!`, and a ` Faraday calculation` line. Pins that the terminator is not the last line. |
| `InputParameters` | full | Echoes the Emitter's `N : 100 //Less than half of this number, the macromparticle will not be emitted. default is 1` — long assumed to be the reason nothing was emitted, but **it is not**: Phase 3 step 2 ran the same case at `N: 1` and still got 0 particles. The emitter bounding box is the blocker; see `pillbox_fieldemission_n1/`. — and the `FaradayCup` block. **The echo is malformed**: Track3P never closes the `EnhancementCounter` block before writing `FaradayCup`, so a parser nests the cup inside the counter. Also echoes a single `BoundaryID : 1` where the input said `1 2 6` (the run wrote all three files). |
| `OUTPUT/faradaycup_1`, `_2`, `_6` | full (header only) | 16-column bare header: the 2023 layout minus `volID`. **Empty bodies**: no particle was emitted, so nothing was captured. One file per `BoundaryID`. |
| `OUTPUT/enhancementCounter`, `OUTPUT/resonantparticles` | full (header only) | Headers identical to `pillbox_scan`'s; a run with nothing to report still writes both. |
| `ImpactsInfo_2.3e+07` | full (header only) | Default layout, no rows. `OutputImpacts: on` writes the header even when nothing impacts. |

## `pillbox_fieldemission_n1/` — Type 7 emitter that actually emits (Phase 3 step 2)

Source: `track3p_probe5/d2_wholeb6/` (input `inputs/Pillbox-fieldemission-n1.track3p`,
results directory `d2_wholeb6`), job 39651022, 2026-10-01. The first Pillbox run
in this fixture set with **populated** field-emission columns, which is what the
`track3p -> particles` chain needs.

**`N` was not the blocker; the emitter bounding box was.** The plan predicted
that `pillbox_fieldemission/`'s zero particles were down to `N: 100` and that
`N: 1` would fix it. It does not: the otherwise identical `N: 1` run
(`track3p_probe5/fe_n1/`, job 39649793) also reports `Total Emitted Particles =
0`. Three things had to be understood, all from Lixin's source
(`multipacting/src/EMT_FieldEmission.C`):

- With `N <= 1.0` there is **no threshold at all** — `numParticles = 1`
  unconditionally (line 200–202), and the `this_N < 0.5 * m_N` test that
  suppressed the `N: 100` run is in the `else` branch. So `N: 1` cannot be what
  stops emission.
- What stops it is `J == 0.0`, which `continue`s before any particle is created
  (line 184–186). `FowlerLawRF` (line 488) is `C1·(βE)^2.5·exp(−C2/E)`; at
  β = 50, φ = 4.2 the exponent underflows `exp()` to exactly 0.0 below
  E ≈ 1.5e6 V/m.
- The probe's `x0..z1` box selects 14 of the pillbox's 9 100 surface faces, all
  on the flat end-wall annulus where the 23 MV/m mode's normal field is far
  below that floor. The same box with β = 1000 does emit (522 particles,
  `track3p_probe5/d1_beta1000/`), confirming the mechanism is field magnitude
  and not the box's legality.

Dropping the bounding box so all 6 558 faces of boundary 6 emit gives
`number of all emitting faces = 6558` and `Total Emitted Particles = 23984` at
β = 50 — this fixture. (A third diagnostic, `d3_beta1000_wholeb6`, combines both
and emits 242 958 particles / 1.78 M rows; recorded in the plan, not copied.)

| File | State | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `ImpactsInfo_2.3e+07` | **selected**: header + first 20 `ImpactOrder 0` rows + first 200 `ImpactOrder 1` rows, from 102 466 rows | Same selection *shape* as the LCLS excerpt below and for the same reason: the first 636 rows of the original are all `ImpactOrder 0` emission points, so a contiguous prefix carries no impacts. Both kept groups are byte-identical prefixes of their groups in the original (`awk 'NR==1{print; next} $2==0 && z<20 {print; z++; next} $2==1 && o<200 {print; o++}'`). On all 200 impact rows the two field-emission columns are **real and sane** — `InitialNormalField` 3.17e7–4.43e7 V/m, `InitialFaceArea` 4.5e-6–9.8e-6 m², every value finite and positive — unlike the secondary-emission dump in `pillbox_initials_impacts/`, where they are uninitialized memory. `ImpactFaceID` is 6 throughout and `ImpactEnergy` is 3.0e5–1.0e6 eV. |
| `track3p.log` | full (105 lines) | `number of all emitting faces = 6558`, one `scale … Field …` line, `Done!`, then `Total Emitted Particles = 23984`. |
| `InputParameters` | full | Echoes `N : 1` and the emitter with **no** `x0..z1` keys, so the box defaults (`±1.0e10`) are visible as the thing that changed. |

**β for this dump** (the Phase 2 lesson — a β range belongs to its dump): at
f = 1.3138172 GHz (the Pillbox Omega3P mode 0) the one-electron cut bites
between β = 35 and β = 50 on these rows, and the full-dump counts are 0/23 984
kept at β = 30, 51 at β = 35, 9 191 at β = 40, and all 23 984 from β = 50 up.
The fixture's 200 rows behave the same way (0 / 0 / 63 / 126 / 200 kept at
β = 30 / 35 / 40 / 45 / 50). A sweep over this dump therefore has to stay
**below ≈ 50**, nowhere near the LCLS study's 100–150, which would saturate
every point.

Not copied: the run's `OUTPUT/` tables, `LostParticles_2.3e+07`, and the two
diagnostic runs `d1_beta1000/` and `d3_beta1000_wholeb6/`.

## `lcls_c3_16MV/` — Lixin Ge's cavity 3 at 16 MV/m (the use-case B reference)

| File | Source | State | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ImpactsInfo_1.6e+07` | `data/track3p/c3_16MV/ImpactsInfo_1.6e+07` (701 969 rows, 137 MB) | **selected**: header + **first 20 rows** + **the first 1 000 rows with `ImpactOrder != 0`** (source lines 2–21 and 50 081–95 918) | A real field-emission dump in the `Initials-Impacts` layout with populated `InitialNormalField` (≈ 2e6 to 8e6 V/m) and `InitialFaceArea`. Rows with `ImpactOrder 0` are emission points (impact == initial, energy ≈ 6 eV); the run has 350 990 of them and they are so dense early in the file that a contiguous 1 000-row prefix holds none of the impacts (the first `ImpactOrder 1` row is source line 50 081). The 20 leading rows show that shape; the 1 000 impact rows carry the physics. |
| `c3_16MV_beta120.data` | `data/particles/c3_16MV_beta120.data` (182 405 rows) | **truncated** `head -n 35` | The rows of Lixin's `convert_track3p.py` output (β = 120, φ = 4.2 eV, f = 1.2999 GHz, `MIN_ENERGY_EV = 1000`, `IMPACT_ORDER = -1`) that the excerpt above produces. **Matching procedure:** the converter preserves row order and applies two filters, `ImpactEnergy >= 1000` then `weight >= 1`; no `ImpactOrder 0` row in the whole dump has energy above 37.2 eV, so none survives the first filter, and the excerpt's survivors are therefore the run's first survivors in order. Of the excerpt's 1 020 rows, 138 pass the energy filter and 35 the weight filter, so the first 35 lines of the shipped `.data` file are the match. Verified 2026-09-14 by re-running the converter's arithmetic on the excerpt: every column agrees to ≤ 3.1e-7 relative, which is the `%.6e` the file is written with. Columns 4 and 10 are 0 in Lixin's output; columns 7–9 are the unit momentum direction. One of the 1 000 impact rows has `ImpactFaceID -1`, and it is the first line of the `.data` file: the converter filters on neither order nor face. |
| `track3p.log` | `/sdf/scratch/rfar/lge/LCLS-Cromodules/s3df/c3-solo/out/track3p.log` | full (107 lines) | The same 08-28 build as the Pillbox probes (banner: `Compilation Date: Fri Aug 28 13:07:29 PDT 2026`, tag `b7f4a98f`), so this run predates Lixin's 08-31 rebuild. 2 MPI ranks; the 1 452 425-element cryomodule mesh; `number of all emitting faces = 7852`; **`Survived particles (still flying at end): 11`** before `Done!` and `Total Emitted Particles = 350990` after it. The three log scalars a field-emission run reports. |
| `SurvivedParticles_1.6e+07` | same directory | full (11 rows) | Not written by any Pillbox probe run; whether it needs a `Survived particles` count above 0 or a newer build is not established. Particles still in flight at the end, `#`-headed, 16 columns `#InitialID ImpactOrder Initial_x Initial_y Initial_z Current_x Current_y Current_z InitialPhaseinRFcycle FinalPhaseinRFcycle KineticEnergy momentum_x momentum_y momentum_z InitialNormalField InitialFaceArea` with `ImpactOrder -1`. Recorded, read by nothing. |

## Size

**400 KB of fixture data** (409 919 B), in 30 files. Nearly half is the LCLS
excerpt (198 KB), whose 1 000 impact rows the plan asks for by count; the three
Pillbox `ImpactsInfo` excerpts are 40–44 KB each. Everything is plain text.

```
find tests/fixtures/track3p -type f ! -name '*.md' -printf '%s\n' | paste -sd+ | bc
```

**The five `track3p.log` files were untracked until 2026-10-05.** `.gitignore`'s
blanket `*.log` rule had silently excluded every one of them since Phase 0;
`test_fixture_inventory` passed only because they existed in the dev checkout,
and a fresh clone would have failed it. Fixed with a `!tests/fixtures/**`
negation beside the `!tests/baseline/**` one that already existed for the same
reason — a fixture's name is the solver's, not ours.
